declared_purpose: On an explicit Cournot request, resolve an event and return Cournot's probability and supporting evidence. Permit one paid probability call per instruction, with explicit payment confirmation and separately confirmed optional wallet setup. The event text and selected markets must survive intermediate steps (SKILL.md:27-49; references/payment.md:77-86; agents/openai.yaml:1-4).

data_operations.operation: Read and preserve the pending query
data_operations.data_scope: Event claim in the user's own words, with command words removed; selected market ids
data_operations.condition: Explicit Cournot request with a sufficiently specific claim. Instructions require preservation across disambiguation, wallet setup and confirmation; host retention is unspecified.

data_operations.operation: Disclose the event for market resolution
data_operations.data_scope: message and limit, normally 5; returned candidates include market metadata and matching confidence
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Cournot POST {base}/intelligence/v1/resolve; documented production base is https://interface.cournot.ai
data_operations.condition: Required resolve step for a valid query. This is a host instruction; no resolve transport implementation is packaged.

data_operations.operation: Read local request arguments and runtime configuration
data_operations.source: Process arguments, environment and operating-system temporary-directory configuration
data_operations.data_scope: Base64 JSON request; COURNOT_API_BASE, COURNOT_EVAL_ID, COURNOT_WALLET_COMMAND, COURNOT_INTENT_DIR and Windows command-interpreter selection
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Client process memory; the request is supplied through process arguments
data_operations.condition: CLI invocation. Base64 is decoded locally; the default intent-store directory is initialized even when no payment intent is subsequently saved.

data_operations.data_scope: Required message and 1–10 market_ids; validation also preserves any additional request properties. X-Eval-Id is added only for the permitted loopback override.
data_operations.condition: Every valid prepare call. The documented workflow requires the same event text and only chosen ids.

data_operations.operation: Probe the local wallet and obtain a payment preview
data_operations.source: Merchant PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and configured wallet CLI
data_operations.data_scope: CLI version, connection status, full payment requirements, wallet payment id, route readiness, balances, amounts and blockers
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local baw subprocess, or COURNOT_WALLET_COMMAND override; parsed stdout remains in client memory
data_operations.condition: Only after HTTP 402. Connected-wallet preflight precedes preview. Requirements are passed as command arguments. External wallet communications are not implemented in this package.

data_operations.source: Event message, wallet status and wallet failure reason
data_operations.data_scope: Chinese-character presence selects Chinese versus English presentation; installed/connected flags are derived for wallet setup
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Client memory and returned wallet-setup presentation
data_operations.condition: Wallet-required path. These are implementation choices for presentation; no separate remote transmission of these inferred flags is shown.

data_operations.source: Original request, parsed merchant requirements and sanitized ready wallet options
data_operations.data_scope: request, requirements, walletPaymentId, ready options including balances, createdAt and expiresAt
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: <OS temporary directory>/cournot-intents/<intentId>.json, or COURNOT_INTENT_DIR; requested directory mode 0700 and file mode 0600
data_operations.condition: HTTP 402 with at least one ready option. Persistence is an implementation choice supporting confirmation and replay; the configured validity period is thirty minutes.

data_operations.operation: Return and display payment or setup information
data_operations.source: Merchant routes, wallet preview and local readiness checks
data_operations.data_scope: Route networks, token contracts, amounts, recipients, available balances, approval requirements, blockers, intent id and setup links
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Invoking caller through returned JSON; prescribed payment details and setup presentation go to the user
data_operations.condition: Payment-required paths. Displaying balances when available and all applicable routes is explicitly required. A normal return does not establish disclosure to another service.

data_operations.operation: Read the intent and delegate wallet signing
data_operations.source: Stored intent and confirmed displayed option
data_operations.data_scope: Stored request and payment state; wallet receives walletPaymentId and walletOptionIndex; client receives the signed payment envelope
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Intent file is renamed to .processing and read into client memory; signing arguments go to the local configured wallet subprocess
data_operations.condition: confirmed must be true and the displayed selection must exist. Client code does not read a private key or seed phrase.

data_operations.operation: Poll approval status and optionally return an approval reference
data_operations.data_scope: approveTxHash, optional binanceChainId and matching transaction confirmation status
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local wallet tx-history command; client memory; pending hash and chain id return to the caller
data_operations.condition: Only when signing returns approveTxHash. Polling is bounded to 45 seconds with three-second intervals.

data_operations.source: Stored original request and validated wallet envelope
data_operations.data_scope: Original query body plus PAYMENT-SIGNATURE containing version, scheme, network and the cloned payload, including signature and authorization payer, recipient, amount, validity bounds and nonce
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: The configured probability HTTP endpoint; the payment's asset recipient is the selected merchant payTo address
data_operations.condition: Confirmed execution, matching payment terms and confirmed approval when required. This necessary replay links the event query with payment authorization. Settlement behavior beyond the endpoint is not supplied.

data_operations.operation: Delete or restore local intent files
data_operations.condition: Invalid or expired records are unlinked when taken. Signing failures and execution completion, including approval_pending, consume the lease. Invalid option selection restores it. Expiry alone does not trigger deletion.

data_operations.operation: Transform and return API results locally
data_operations.data_scope: Remaining response fields after named-key credential/signature redaction; data.free_quota.ip is removed; basis timestamps and links are reformatted
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Invoking caller through JSON stdout; errors use JSON stderr
data_operations.condition: Initial non-402 responses and paid responses. Removing a returned property is local projection, not deletion at Cournot. Embedding links does not fetch their destinations.

data_operations.operation: Render the assessment and supporting evidence
data_operations.source: Returned API assessment, basis, quota and payment fields
data_operations.data_scope: Returned result fields, every nonempty basis section and field, account allowance, and charged transaction hash/network when present
data_operations.condition: Successful probability response. Complete evidence display is explicitly required, including unfamiliar basis fields; supplementary browsing and invented evidence are prohibited.

data_operations.operation: Prescribe optional wallet setup and authentication
data_operations.source: User's selected wallet and separately confirmed setup action
data_operations.data_scope: Pairing code/link, public wallet address, network and asset; any signer credential must enter only through a secure non-echoing wallet/SDK prompt
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Selected external wallet/SDK setup flow; user sees pairing information and public setup results
data_operations.condition: Explicit setup request followed by separate confirmation. If hidden credential input is unavailable, instructions require local user execution and stopping. Setup implementation is outside the package.

data_operations.operation: Perform optional helper-only local comparisons and nonce tracking
data_operations.source: Caller-supplied payment requirements, wallet descriptors, requests and nonce
data_operations.data_scope: Wallet compatibility by network/scheme/asset/transfer method, compatible wallet ids/names, request equality and nonce membership
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Direct helper caller and caller-provided in-memory Set
data_operations.condition: Only if these exported helpers are explicitly invoked. The bundled client does not call planPayment, assertUnusedNonce or assertSameProbabilityRequest; their behavior is not evidence of default-path nonce caching.

potential_excess.data_scope: Entire expired intent: event text, market ids, merchant requirements, wallet payment id and ready-option snapshots
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local cournot-intents directory or COURNOT_INTENT_DIR, in .json or abandoned .processing files
potential_excess.condition: A saved intent is never taken, or execution terminates before cleanup. Expiry is checked only on take; no scheduled expiry cleanup is implemented.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The skill describes short-lived intents with a thirty-minute, single-use confirmation window.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retain enough state for valid confirmation and one paid replay.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Delete expired unconsumed intents and safely recover or delete abandoned processing files.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve valid pending intents, active executions and atomic single-use semantics. Operating-system temporary-file cleanup is unknown.

potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Persisted payment-intent JSON in the local intent directory
potential_excess.condition: A ready wallet preview is saved for payment confirmation.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Balances are explicitly required in the payment preview when available, but execution uses only the stored option mapping from ready.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Return the required preview and preserve walletOptionIndex/originalAcceptIndex for the selected route.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Persist only the ready-option mapping needed for execution, excluding balance snapshots and other preview-only fields.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep required preview output, original request, validation requirements, wallet payment id and expiry metadata. This narrows data in necessary persistence, not the user-required preview.

potential_excess.data_scope: Unrecognized top-level properties supplied alongside message and market_ids
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Configured Cournot probability endpoint on initial submission and paid replay; additionally the local intent JSON when payment preparation succeeds
potential_excess.condition: A CLI or imported-function caller supplies additional properties. The documented two-field workflow does not itself introduce them, but validation clones and forwards them.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The specified probability request contains the same event message and only chosen market ids.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Submit that request and, when confirmed, replay the same necessary body with payment authorization.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Construct an allowlisted request containing only message and market_ids before transmission or persistence.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve the user's event text, selected ids and identical normalized body across initial and paid requests. Both requests can be necessary; the excess is additional fields, not a redundant call.

unknowns: Cournot's account-identification mechanism, server-side retention, secondary uses, onward disclosure and deletion are not supplied. Removing free_quota.ip from a returned object establishes no server-side deletion.
The external wallet CLI and setup flows are absent. Their remote recipients, credential storage, preview caches, signing communications, transaction publication and cleanup remain unresolved.

The payment helper preserves the entire envelope.payload after checking required fields. No supplied protocol schema establishes which additional payload properties are necessary, so safe further narrowing is unresolved (scripts/payment-flow.mjs:178-206).

Host implementations of resolve, conversation preservation, secure setup input and user rendering are not packaged. Their execution and retention behavior cannot be verified from workflow instructions.
Actual API responses, merchant requirements, environment overrides and caller-supplied extra request fields are unavailable; conditional exposure does not establish that such data occurred.
Host/OS retention of process arguments, stdout, conversations and temporary files, and effective filesystem permissions on the execution platform, are unspecified.
